bias.en: Bearish · oversold after a 21% drop under $50.8
bias.zh: 看空 · 下跌 21% 跌破 $50.8 后超卖

read.en: AAOI fell 20.9% on Nov 5 to $46.89, trading $45.88–56.89 on 2.2 times its 20-day average volume. It is below the falling 5-day ($60.34), 10-day ($67.95), 30-day ($87.82) and 100-day ($109.57) and the rising 200-day ($114.59) averages. MACD has been below its signal since Oct 13, below zero, with the histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 12 ($72.48), and RSI is 27, oversold.
read.zh: AAOI 11月5日下跌 20.9%，收于 $46.89，盘中区间 $45.88–56.89，成交量为 20 日均量的 2.2 倍。股价位于下行的 5 日（$60.34）、10 日（$67.95）、30 日（$87.82）和 100 日均线（$109.57）以及上行的 200 日均线（$114.59）下方。MACD 自 10月13日起位于信号线下方，处于零轴下方，柱状图扩大；抛物线 SAR 自 10月12日起看空（$72.48），RSI 为 27，处于超卖区。

read.en: The gap lower broke the $57.3 Nov 4 low and the $50.8 Feb 11 high, the last two written supports, and the close is the lowest since Feb 18. Resistance is $50.8, then $56.9–57.3 (Nov 5 high, Nov 4 low) and $60.3–62.3 (5-day, Nov 2–3 lows). Support is $45.9 (Nov 5 low), then $41.1–42.0 (Feb 17 low, Dec 23 high). A close above $50.8 would target $57; below $45.9, $41–42.
read.zh: 跳空下跌跌破 11月4日低点 $57.3 和 2月11日高点 $50.8 这两个原有支撑，收盘为 2月18日以来最低。阻力为 $50.8，其次 $56.9–57.3（11月5日高点、11月4日低点）和 $60.3–62.3（5 日均线、11月2–3日低点）。支撑为 $45.9（11月5日低点），其次 $41.1–42.0（2月17日低点、12月23日高点）。若收盘站上 $50.8，下一目标看 $57；若跌破 $45.9，则看 $41–42。
